question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Abstinence
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Gluttony'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Abstinence" **refers to the act of voluntarily refraining from indulging in something, usually pertaining to pleasurable activities like eating certain foods or drinking alcohol.
 
• **Gluttony:** This is the correct answer. "Gluttony" is the habit or act of eating or consuming to excess.(भोजन की अत्यधिक तृष्णा) 
 
• **It represents** indulgence in the very activities from which one abstains when practicing "abstinence". 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Gluttony'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's examine all the options one by one:
 
 
• **Celibacy:** This refers to the state of abstaining from marriage and sexual relations. It is actually a form of abstinence(ब्रह्मचर्य)
 
• **Continence:** This is the ability to control movements of the bowels and bladder, but it can also mean self-restraint or abstinence, especially in regard to sexual activity.(संयम)
 
• **Control: **This refers to the power to influence or direct people's behavior or the course of events. (नियंत्रण)
 
 

37:Tacf,

The correct answer is 'Option 4'
